source.label: Fiscal 2025 Form 10-K, Item 5
source.quote: As of April 2, 2026, there were approximately 134 stockholders of record of our Class A common stock and zero stockholders of record of our Class B common stock.

notes: NBIM: NBIM's June 30, 2026 equity holdings file has no line for Rent the Runway (searched by name). CalPERS: its Form 13F information table for the quarter ended September 30, 2026 lists no Rent the Runway shares (searched by name). Holders of record: Class A only; the 10-K gives zero holders of record of Class B, which was eliminated in the October 2025 recapitalization.
